afghanistan.original:
دوست صادق
همچون برادر است،
همیشه با تو.
afghanistan.translation:
A true friend
is like a brother,
always with you.
afghanistan.author: Dari proverb

argentina.original:
Entre amigos del alma,
el asado y el mate,
vida de hermanos.
argentina.translation:
Among soulful friends,
with asado and mate,
life of brothers.
argentina.author: Argentine saying

australia.original:
Mates by the billabong,
under southern stars,
true blue forever.
australia.translation:
Mates by the billabong,
under southern stars,
true blue forever.
australia.author: Australian verse

belgium.original:
Vriendschap als bier,
beter met de tijd,
altijd welkom thuis.
belgium.translation:
Friendship like beer,
better with time,
always welcome home.
belgium.author: Belgian saying

china.original:
朋友如兄弟
家人似明月
照亮人生路。
china.translation:
Friends like brothers,
family like bright moon,
lighting life's path.
china.author: Chinese verse

colombia.original:
La familia es raíz,
los amigos son alas,
vida completa.
colombia.translation:
Family is the root,
friends are the wings,
life is complete.
colombia.author: Colombian saying

cuba.original:
La familia cubana
es música y amor,
ritmo del corazón.
cuba.translation:
The Cuban family
is music and love,
rhythm of the heart.
cuba.author: Cuban verse

ethiopia.original:
ወዳጅ ሰው
እንደ ወንድም ነው፣
ልብን ይሞቅልናል።
ethiopia.translation:
A true friend
is like a brother,
he warms the heart.
ethiopia.author: Amharic proverb

finland.original:
Ystävä on tuli,
joka lämmittää sydäntä,
talven kylmyydessä.
finland.translation:
A friend is a fire,
that warms the heart,
in the winter's cold.
finland.author: Finnish proverb

france.original:
Famille unie,
force infinie,
coeur tranquille.
france.translation:
A united family,
infinite strength,
a peaceful heart.
france.author: French proverb

germany.original:
Freunde sind Familie,
die man selbst wählt,
Herz an Herz.
germany.translation:
Friends are family,
that we choose ourselves,
heart to heart.
germany.author: German saying

hk.original:
朋友如茶，
共飲方香甜，
暖心長久。
hk.translation:
Friends are like tea,
sweeter when shared,
warming the heart forever.
hk.author: Cantonese verse

iceland.original:
Vinir eru sól
í vetrarmyrkri,
hlýja hjartað.
iceland.translation:
Friends are sun
in winter darkness,
warming the heart.
iceland.author: Icelandic verse

india.original:
सच्चा मित्र
जीवन का धन है,
सदा संग रहता।
india.translation:
A true friend
is life's treasure,
always stays with you.
india.author: Hindi proverb

iran.original:
دوست راستین
گنجی است گرانبها،
تا ابد پایدار.
iran.translation:
A true friend
is a precious treasure,
enduring forever.
iran.author: Persian proverb

italy.original:
Amici come famiglia,
intorno alla tavola,
amore che nutre.
italy.translation:
Friends like family,
around the table,
love that nourishes.
italy.author: Italian saying

japan_lunch.original:
友と共に
食卓を囲み
春の光。
japan_lunch.translation:
With friends together,
around the table,
in spring's light.
japan_lunch.author: Japanese haiku style

laos.original:
ເພື່ອນແທ້
ຄືປາຊີເຄິນ
ເຊື່ອຟັງໃຈ.
laos.translation:
A true friend
is like family,
trusted in the heart.
laos.author: Lao proverb

malaysia.original:
Keluarga adalah harta,
sahabat adalah cahaya,
keduanya memberkati.
malaysia.translation:
Family is treasure,
friends are light,
both bring blessings.
malaysia.author: Malay saying

mexico.original:
La familia mexicana
es fiesta y tradición,
corazón que late fuerte.
mexico.translation:
The Mexican family
is celebration and tradition,
a heart that beats strong.
mexico.author: Mexican verse

mongolia.original:
Найз залуу гэр бүл
мөнгөнөөс үнэтэй,
эцэг эхийг хүндэтгэ.
mongolia.translation:
Good friends and family
are more precious than silver,
honor your parents.
mongolia.author: Mongolian wisdom

netherlands.original:
Vrienden lachen samen,
zoals wind door tulpen—
vrolijk en vrij.
netherlands.translation:
Friends laugh together,
like wind through tulips—
cheerful and free.
netherlands.author: Dutch verse

norway.original:
Venner under nordlys,
hjerter som gløder,
kjærlighet evig.
norway.translation:
Friends under northern lights,
hearts that glow,
love eternal.
norway.author: Norwegian verse

nz.original:
He tangata, he tangata,
he tangata.
Ko te mea nui.
nz.translation:
It is people, it is people,
it is people.
That is what matters most.
nz.author: Māori proverb (Whakataukī)

nz_maori.original:
Ko te whānau
te taonga nui,
ko te aroha te here.
nz_maori.translation:
Family is
the greatest treasure,
love is the bond.
nz_maori.author: Māori whakatauki

philipines.original:
Ang pamilya ay tahanan,
ang kaibigan ay kalinga,
parehong kayamanan.
philipines.translation:
Family is a home,
friends are care,
both are treasures.
philipines.author: Tagalog saying

png.original:
Ol wantok,
ol famili,
spes bilong yumi.
png.translation:
Our wantoks,
our family,
are our strength.
png.author: Tok Pisin proverb

russia.original:
Без семьи
и солнце не светит —
жизнь темна.
russia.translation:
Without family,
even the sun does not shine—
life is dark.
russia.author: Russian proverb

saudi.original:
الصديق الوفي
نعمة من الله،
يبقى للأبد.
saudi.translation:
A loyal friend
is a blessing from God,
lasting forever.
saudi.author: Arabic proverb

south_sudan.original:
Family is life,
friendship is peace,
we walk together.
south_sudan.translation:
Family is life,
friendship is peace,
we walk together.
south_sudan.author: South Sudanese proverb

spain.original:
Donde hay amigos,
hay alegría sin fin,
como en la familia.
spain.translation:
Where there are friends,
there is endless joy,
like in a family.
spain.author: Spanish proverb

srilanka.original:
කුටුඹය සුරක්ෂිතයි,
මිතුරන් සතුට ගෙනෙයි—
ජීවිතය සම්පූර්ණයි.
srilanka.translation:
Family gives safety,
friends bring joy—
life is complete.
srilanka.author: Sinhala verse

sweden.original:
Vänner vid bordet,
ljuset blir varmare,
hemmet känns helt.
sweden.translation:
Friends at the table,
the light grows warmer,
home feels complete.
sweden.author: Swedish verse

switzerland.original:
Freundschaft wie Berge,
steht stark im Sturm,
bleibt ewig.
switzerland.translation:
Friendship like mountains,
stands strong in storms,
remains forever.
switzerland.author: Swiss German verse

taiwan.original:
好朋友相聚
如春花盛開
心暖如家。
taiwan.translation:
Good friends gathering
like spring flowers blooming,
heart warm like home.
taiwan.author: Taiwanese verse

uk.original:
Home is where
kind hearts gather,
never apart.
uk.translation:
Home is where
kind hearts gather,
never apart.
uk.author: English proverb

usa.original:
From sea to shining sea,
friends gather 'round the table,
home is where hearts meet.
usa.translation:
From sea to shining sea,
friends gather 'round the table,
home is where hearts meet.
usa.author: American verse

uzbekistan.original:
Do'st - jonning yarmi,
oila - yurakningning uyі,
mehribon bo'l.
uzbekistan.translation:
Friend is half of life,
family is the heart's home,
be loving.
uzbekistan.author: Uzbek saying
